description: This Java source file implements a utility class UelUtil for evaluating and manipulating Unified Expression Language (UEL) expressions within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for evaluating expressions, setting and removing values, and handling variable resolution with support for localized maps and custom resolvers.

classes.name: UelUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for evaluating and manipulating UEL expressions, with internal classes for context and variable resolution.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a UEL expression with a given context and expected return type.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a UEL expression within a given context.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes (sets to null) the value of a UEL expression within a given context.

methods.name: getLocalizedMapLocaleKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for locale resolution in LocalizedMap instances.

methods.name: prepareExpression
methods.description: Converts OFBiz-specific expression syntax into UEL-compatible syntax.
